about_the_game:
Become an arena fighter and earn glory by defeating your enemies and making it to the top! 

Entertain The Crowd

Get paid out after each fight based on how well you entertained the crowd. Use your gold to buy weapons, shields, and armor. The crowd likes when you put on a show, so attack, parry, and emote on your enemies to gain popularity!

Choose Your Combat Style

Choose between using a sword and shield, dual wielding, or using beefy two-handed weapons. Each style has it's own benefits and drawbacks. Block, dodge, parry, and tank hits the way you see fit!

Level Up Your Skills

Earn skill points that you can spend on 6 different skill types. These skills have unique benefits and allow you to refine your play style the way you like.

Enchant Your Gear

Gain soul points through fights and use them to enchant your weapons. Watch out though: not all enchantments are good! You can choose to play it safe or hope your gamble pays off!

Random Arenas And Events

Entertain the crowd in different arenas and random events, making each fight come with it's own unique challenges. 

Interact With The Town

Talk to the people of the town and help them out to get bonuses that will help you on your way to the top! 

Key Features -

  • Souls-lite roguelite - Challenging and dynamic combat

  • Co-op multiplayer - Become champions together

  • Class System - Buy starting classes with in game currency you get from defeating bosses

  • Difficulty adjustments - from easy to gladiator mode, choose what fits your skill level

  • Test your luck - Gamble for the most powerful enchantments and face beneficial or harmful events each fight!

  • Overpowered emotes - Use emotes strategically to gain favor with the crowd

  • Face new challenges - Each run will have new challenges randomly chosen based on the difficulty

  • Autosave - Stop whenever and pick back up where you left off

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 470 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
